items.name: Patroni: cluster snapshot
items.description: Cluster topology from Patroni REST API. The endpoint is a monitoring source, not a fixed leader.

parameters: var d=JSON.parse(value); if(d.scope!=="{$PATRONI.SCOPE}" || !Array.isArray(d.members)) throw "Unexpected Patroni cluster"; return JSON.stringify(d);

triggers.name: Patroni: no cluster data for 3 minutes

parameters: var d=JSON.parse(value); return d.scope;
var d=JSON.parse(value); var a=d.members.filter(function(m){return m.role==="leader";}); if(a.length!==1) throw "Expected exactly one leader"; return a[0].name;
var d=JSON.parse(value); return d.members.filter(function(m){return m.role==="leader";}).length;
var d=JSON.parse(value); return d.members.length;

items.name: Patroni: nodes reported running or streaming

parameters: var d=JSON.parse(value); return d.members.filter(function(m){return m.state==="running" || m.state==="streaming";}).length;

triggers.name: Patroni: fewer running/streaming nodes than expected

parameters: var d=JSON.parse(value); var a=d.members.filter(function(m){return m.name==="{$PATRONI.DR_MEMBER}";}); if(a.length!==1) throw "Member missing or duplicated"; var m=a[0]; var v=m.role; if(v===null || typeof v==="undefined") throw "Metric unavailable for current role"; return v;

var d=JSON.parse(value); var a=d.members.filter(function(m){return m.name==="{$PATRONI.DR_MEMBER}";}); if(a.length!==1) throw "Member missing or duplicated"; var m=a[0]; var v=m.state; if(v===null || typeof v==="undefined") throw "Metric unavailable for current role"; return v;
